name: cascade_delete
description: In function delete_customer, the code explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer with `DELETE FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = ?`. This matches an application-level cascade delete, and it affects the separate read endpoint list_orders, which reads from `orders`; after customer deletion, those order rows are permanently removed so `/api/orders` returns missing/incomplete data.
